BusanSat is a 12U nano satellite, designed to measure fine dust in the sea atmosphere with a polarimetric camera.
Description

Measures the amount of fine dust particles and super thin clouds in the sea atmosphere by performing polarimetric observations toward Yellow Sea once a day.

  • **SPATIAL RESOLUTION **388 m
  • **FIELD OF VIEW **98 km x 98 km
  • **PAYLOAD **Polarimetric Observation (410nm, 550nm, 864nm)
